description: Everything you've played, newest first: luck boards, invented games, skill runs, Arena and room seats, with stake, payout and state, plus lifetime totals. Use it to review results or find a round to check. A luck-board play carries `verify`: pass it straight to verify_play. For older plays, pass the last play's `at` as `before`. For your balance alone, use get_me.

before.description: Only plays before this time (ms): the last play's `at`, for the next page
